message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 76.2% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and testing. I want to become a Software Systems Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 10500 per year. I live in Mumbai. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India.
explanation:
This program is located in Mumbai, matching your strong preference to stay near home. It focuses on Software Quality Engineering and Software Engineering, aligning well with your interest in testing and your goal of becoming a Software Systems Engineer.

This option is also located in Mumbai and offers an MSc in Software Engineering. It directly addresses your career goal while keeping you close to home, and the low tuition cost helps meet your budget constraints.

Located in Pune (a reasonable alternative to Mumbai), this MTech program covers Software Engineering and Networking/Cloud. Since you have an IT background, the requirement for a CS background is met, making it highly relevant to your career path.

While located in Bengaluru (a slight deviation from Mumbai), this MSc program offers strong alignment with Software Engineering and QA Testing. It has a high placement rate and is within your budget.

This MDes program in Pune provides exposure to Interaction Design and Software Engineering. Although it focuses on design, its location and core engineering field make it a viable option that respects your preference for staying near home.
